title: Flat recency sort: show activity age in rows, remove All-mode section headers
source: exploration plan §4-5: default to flat global last-activity order, show activity time in row, Saved is a facet not implicit override
why_chosen: Directly addresses the 'Ordering uses descending last_message_time but the visible timestamp says created' confusion and the section-header partitioning. High user-visible impact with minimal code change.
before: The row line3 showed 'created: N ago' but the list was sorted by last_message_time. In All mode, sessions were partitioned into Saved/Server/Orphan sections with headers, breaking global recency. Saved sessions got their own header group instead of being mixed in with the 📌 badge.
after: Row line3 now shows the activity age ('5m ago' etc.) derived from last_message_time, matching the sort order. All mode shows one flat recency-sorted list without section headers. Saved sessions are still indicated via the 📌 badge. Server group info remains accessible via details/onboarding.
evidence: All 95 existing session_picker tests pass. Compilation succeeds. Removal of ~120 lines of section-header grouping logic.
open_questions: Should Saved/Orphan/Server header enum variants be removed from PickerItem now that they're unused? (minor cleanup, deferred)
